catches: EXPIRING 9/30/2026 (7 days from verification) — flagged per the 14-day rule. Bonus offer is valid July 1, 2026 – September 30, 2026, and 'subject to change or termination at any time without notice.'

Requires opening a new consumer checking account (BankOn Checking excluded) with a $25 minimum opening deposit, then within 90 days: a minimum of 15 qualifying Visa debit card transactions (point-of-sale only; ATM transactions do not qualify) AND an aggregate of $500 in qualifying direct deposits (qualifying electronic deposits; person-to-person transfers may not qualify).
The account must be open a minimum of 90 days; 'Early closing fee may apply.'
Limited to one bonus per tax identification number; clients who have previously received a new account bonus are not eligible; cannot be combined with other offers.

steps: Open a new CRBT consumer checking account (BankOn Checking excluded; $25 minimum opening deposit) during the offer window, choosing the $425 credit option (online applications default to $425 credit).

Within 90 calendar days of opening: post at least 15 qualifying Visa debit card point-of-sale transactions (ATM transactions do not qualify) and an aggregate of $500 in qualifying direct deposits (electronic deposits; P2P transfers may not qualify).
Keep the account open at least 90 days; the $425 bonus is paid within 30 days after the end of the 90-day qualifying period.
timing: Bonus paid within 30 days after the end of the 90-day qualifying period, if requirements are met; account must be open a minimum of 90 days.
